guideline_findings.finding: There are doubled spaces at seg/conditional joins: a trailing space inside the seg is followed by a separator space, e.g. 'יוֹם </tei:seg> <j:conditional', 'וְנֶאֱמַר,  <tei:milestone', and 'ח׳</tei:note>  <j:conditional'. This is only a whitespace issue. No words or marks are affected.

Stanza fragments 2–5 all carry page_start:true, although they continue on the same printed page 101 as stanza 1. The generated XML correctly has a single pb n=101, so the output is not affected. The flag is still inconsistent in the input.
